failure_cases.expected_resolution: Handle return per policy

failure_cases.expected_resolution: Correct account information upstream

failure_cases.expected_resolution: Query core posting status before replay

failure_cases.expected_resolution: Match ACH, settlement, and posting records; resolve difference
